title: C → D → A loop
description: Three mapped wallets forming a loop: A sends 2 SOL to C, C sends 150 USDC to D, D sends 149.5 USDC back to A. D also has a fee-only failed transfer attempt to an external address.

45SL1VsqzpPuFPDDkFQBCo2WEG8VQdibQX9GMambpxudrEyNF42AwkDdqTsoHAeM2YMnEFK7pHmKKekNu8Wav1mY (A→C 500 USDC, 2026-07-30) is before range.start: it appears in the recorded getSignaturesForAddress pages for A and C but not in expected and has no getTransaction recording.
The failed tx touches external address 73DukgjXUhkSwK27MTF74FWKG3WDMYDgu55FbsfRzADX (observed, not mapped), so it is D-only and not shared.
C starts with 0.012 SOL; its USDC comes from the pre-range funding tx. D keeps 0.5 USDC (150 in, 149.5 out); all SOL movement besides A→C is fees.
Synthetic: ATA addresses are sha256-derived, not real PDAs. All transactions are legacy.
